title: Reduced-belt transient mechanics: equation sensitivity and Baja operating envelope
scientific_question: Which surviving transient terms in CINDER's final reduced-belt equations can become mechanically important, what physical variables make them grow, and does a reasonable Baja operating envelope actually reach those conditions?
analysis_lenses: ratio and belt-speed coverage through disturbance timing

baja_envelope.negative_grade_semantics: downhill/unloading under the normal full-throttle engine boundary; not asserted closed-throttle overrun

decision_gate: No belt reduction is introduced until equation-level growth thresholds and the physically bounded Baja envelope are interpreted together and a small set of trajectory cases visibly connects predicted sensitivity to observed mechanics.
